opening.argument: This is a recorded panel featuring representatives of the Stellar Development Foundation and Aptos Labs discussing institutional engagement, tokenization, interoperability, and stablecoin use cases. The discussion is analytical and grounded in practical questions, including which assets should be tokenized and whether they trade meaningfully in traditional markets. It identifies remittance, microfinancing, and cross-border transactions as possible applications, while treating regulatory clarity and interoperability as conditions for broader adoption. References to placing real-world assets into DeFi or deploying stablecoins into money-market funds and private credit describe financial use cases, but do not themselves promise a return or solicit a deceptive transaction.
